relations.text: Ichorが年次報告で、最上位のOEM顧客の1社としてASMLを挙げている
relations.text_en: Ichor’s annual report names ASML among its top-tier OEM customers

source.label: Ichor Holdings Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have established deep relationships with top tier OEMs, including Lam Research, Applied Materials, and ASML.
source.note: 相手側の資料にもとづく関係です。

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、Intel 4・Intel 3・Intel 18AなどのEUV露光装置はASMLが唯一の供給元と記載
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report states ASML is the sole supplier of the EUV lithography tools it deploys

source.label: Intel Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ASML Holding N.V. (ASML) is currently the sole supplier of EUV lithography tools that we are deploying in our Intel 4, Intel 3, Intel 18A and planned future leading-edge manufacturing process nodes.

relations.text: IntelがHigh-NA EUV「TWINSCAN EXE:5200」の初の発注をASMLへ(2022年1月)
relations.text_en: Intel placed its first purchase order for the High-NA EUV TWINSCAN EXE:5200 (January 2022)

source.label: ASML Form 6-K(joint の発表 with Intel, 2022-01-19)
source.label_en: ASML Form 6-K (joint press release with Intel, 2022-01-19)
source.quote: Intel has issued its first purchase order to ASML for the delivery of the industry's first TWINSCAN EXE:5200 system

relations.text: IntelとASMLが、Intel FoundryでHigh-NA EUVを量産に使っていると発表(2026年9月8日)
relations.text_en: Intel Foundry and ASML report High-NA EUV used in high-volume manufacturing at Intel Foundry (September 8, 2026)

source.label: Intel の発表(Intel Foundry and ASML, 2026-09-08)
source.label_en: Intel press release (Intel Foundry and ASML, 2026-09-08)
source.quote: High NA continues to be used in high-volume manufacturing production at Intel Foundry today , with more than one million wafers processed to date across early tool certification and testing, research and development efforts, and volume production on select layers for a subset of Intel
source.note: 処理したウエハー数には、装置の認定・研究開発・量産が含まれます。
source.note_en: The wafer count includes tool certification, R&D and volume production.

relations.text: M16工場に、量産向けで業界初となるHigh-NA EUV「EXE:5200B」を導入(2025年9月3日、SK hynixの発表)
relations.text_en: Brought the ASML EXE:5200B High-NA EUV system to its M16 fab, an industry first for commercial use (SK hynix, September 3, 2025)

source.label: SK hynix の発表
source.quote: Brings ASML's EXE:5200B, critical system for next-generation chips, to M16 fab

relations.text: TSMCの「グリーン製造の優秀サプライヤー賞」を受賞(2025年11月、ASMLの年次報告)
relations.text_en: Received the TSMC Supplier Excellence in Green Manufacturing Award (November 2025, per ASML’s annual report)

source.label: ASML Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In November 2025, we were honored to receive the TSMC Supplier 'Excellence in Green Manufacturing' Award
source.note: 表彰の記載で、販売条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: An award only; sales terms are not described.

relations.text: DUV露光装置ではCanonとNikonが主な競合と記載(年次報告)
relations.text_en: Names Canon and Nikon as its primary competitors in DUV systems (annual report)

source.label: ASML Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete primarily with Canon and Nikon in respect of DUV systems.

relations.text: DUV露光装置ではCanonとNikonが主な競合と記載(年次報告)

source.label: ASML Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete primarily with Canon and Nikon in respect of DUV systems.

relations.text: 複雑なパターニングを支えるアプリケーションの競合の例としてApplied Materialsを記載(年次報告)

source.quote: We also compete with providers of applications that support or enhance complex patterning solutions, such as Applied Materials Inc. and KLA-Tencor Corporation.

source.quote: We also compete with providers of applications that support or enhance complex patterning solutions, such as Applied Materials Inc. and KLA-Tencor Corporation.

relations.text: KLAが年次報告で、競合としてASMLを挙げている
relations.text_en: KLA’s annual report lists ASML among its competitors

source.label: KLA Form 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: we have many competitors, including companies such as Applied Materials, Inc., ASML Holding N.V., Hitachi High-Tech Corporation, Lasertec, Inc. and Onto Innovation, Inc.

relations.text: Novaが年次報告で、工程内センサーの競合としてASML・Lam・Applied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Nova’s annual report names ASML, Lam and Applied Materials among process equipment makers developing in-situ sensors

source.label: Nova Ltd Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: we compete with process equipment manufacturers, such as ASML Holdings N.V., LAM Research, and Applied Materials Inc., which develop (or may acquire companies which develop) in-situ sensors and metrology products.
source.note: 工程内センサーなどに限った記載です。
source.note_en: Limited to in-situ sensors and similar products.
